title: docs(skills): objectstack-ui teaches navigation: { openNewTab: true } for a list that opens records in a new tab
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ
Closes #36334

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：客户项目里的 AI 照着界面技能包配置对象列表时，会写对「在新标签页打开记录」。以前技能只说旧的 `navigation.mode: 'new_window'` 在列表上不生效，却没说该怎么写；现在明确写 `navigation: { openNewTab: true }`，并说明手机上总是在当前页打开。
- 为什么做：协议早已支持 `openNewTab`，`new_window` 在对象列表上已废弃（D3 条目 navigation-mode-record-open-deprecated），技能文字没跟上，AI 只知道删掉旧写法、不知道新写法。
- 出错会怎样：只改技能文字，不改任何代码和校验；写错了 AI 会学到错的配置，撤回即恢复原文。
- 要你做什么：这是受管的技能包改动，两级审核通过后请你批准或合并（审核记录会贴在本 PR 上）。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md`, step 5 now reads: "`navigation.mode` is deprecated there: `drawer`, `page`, `new_window` change nothing, so omit it; for a new tab write `navigation: { openNewTab: true }`; `none` still opens nothing (prefer `preventNavigation: true`); a page block's `navigation` honours every value; `modal`/`split`/`popover` are refused with their fix. A phone always pages in place."
- The new wording matches the spec at `fbb62e1c`, `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`:
  - line 3061: `new_window` is ignored on an object's list; write `openNewTab: true`.
  - lines 3111–3112: `openNewTab: true` opens the page in a new tab.
  - line 3137: rows that open nothing stay that way; a phone opens the page in place.
  - the D3 entry `navigation-mode-record-open-deprecated`.
- The bytes are paid for in the same file. Steps 1, 3, 4, 5 and 6 and the intro line are tightened without removing any fact. No ratchet row changes and no eval changes; no case asks about new tabs.
- `.changeset/36334-skills-list-open-new-tab.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

## Tests

The change is text only, so there is no ablation.
